data.body: [P2] This one-time closing check does not prevent post-close user work. A continuation can pass it, wait for its previous worker, then race `stopCheckpointContinuations()`: `closing` is set before owner futures are completed outside the monitor, allowing the next step/predicate worker to start and run side effects after invocation teardown has begun. Make worker-start admission atomic with closing—for example, have the wrapped user worker check manager closing state at its start—and add a gated regression test for this window.
